# ultrastable/seed

**Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.**

A system is autonomous if it has self-referential loops and the ability to close them.

One idea file in, a running organization of virtual managers and staff out.

**The organization:** [ultrastable](https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable) · **seed** · [platform](https://github.com/ultrastable/platform) · [docs](https://github.com/ultrastable/docs) · [site](https://github.com/ultrastable/site) · [business](https://github.com/ultrastable/business) · [ip](https://github.com/ultrastable/ip) · [ultrastable.io](https://ultrastable.io)

## What it is
One idea file in, a running organization of virtual managers and staff out. Ultrastable is an autonomous development platform: an organization of virtual managers and staff that runs projects, scores its own decisions, earns wider autonomy from its track record, and interrupts a person only for steps that cannot be undone.

<p align="center"><img src="assets/brand/loop.png" alt="The loop every manager runs: predict, execute, verify, score, plus" width="90%"></p>

## Who it is for
Founders and makers with an idea and no team.

## Quickstart
```sh
python3 bootstrap/bootstrap.py --dry-run
```

## It runs on itself
Ultrastable runs on itself: its roadmap, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget and specs are run by the same code it gives everyone else, from this repository alone, with any tools (`python3 -m foundation selfhost`).

The proof lives in [ultrastable/ultrastable](https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable): run `python3 -m foundation selfhost --verify` there. This repo is one of the parts it runs.


<p align="center"><img src="assets/brand/self-reference.png" alt="Ultrastable runs on itself" width="80%"></p>

## All repositories
<p align="center"><img src="assets/brand/repo-map.png" alt="Seven repositories, one system" width="90%"></p>

| Repo | Role | What |
|---|---|---|
| [ultrastable](https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable) | System of record | The system of record: roadmap, doctrine, foundation code, agents, brand and the self-hosting proof. |
| [seed](https://github.com/ultrastable/seed) | Bootstrapper | One idea file in, a running organization of virtual managers and staff out. |
| [platform](https://github.com/ultrastable/platform) | Runtime and adapters | The tick, roles, trust ledger, prediction scorer and plussing queue, portable across Cloudflare and Google Cloud. |
| [docs](https://github.com/ultrastable/docs) | Concepts and roadmap | How it works: virtual staff, feedback loops, earned trust, plussing, governance, bootstrapping and the roadmap. |
| [site](https://github.com/ultrastable/site) | Public site | The Cloudflare Worker behind the Ultrastable domains. |
| [business](https://github.com/ultrastable/business) | Plan and funding | Business plan, customers, competition, pitch, funding and promotion, written by the virtual managers. |
| [ip](https://github.com/ultrastable/ip) | Architecture and IP | Architecture specifications, the evidence log, and the archived patent drafts (patent track dropped 2026-11-11). |

Also in the org: [workers](https://github.com/ultrastable/workers), [spec](https://github.com/ultrastable/spec), [license](https://github.com/ultrastable/license) (extracted code, specifications and canonical license text).

## Memory
Code is the only memory. All project state lives in the ultrastable/ultrastable repository (docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md and data files). No agent relies on chat, tool or platform memory; a thread is never the only record.
